q: The Künneth formula for the homology of a product space X × Y (over a field k) gives:
exp: Künneth over a field: Hₙ(X×Y;k) = ⊕_{p+q=n} Hₚ(X;k) ⊗ H_q(Y;k). Over ℤ there is a correction term Tor(H_{p-1}(X), H_q(Y)). Over a field, the graded homology is the tensor product of graded homologies — a clean multiplicative structure.
